333.text: "It is long past time we acknowledge the growing numbers of Dastnurists in our society, and the contributions they make to this nation."

334.speaker: Manus Sazon
334.text: "And from what I can tell, the populace has welcomed the chance to celebrate twice as many public holidays as before."

335.speaker: Narrator
335.text: There was some polite laughter among the RPP delegates. Daria frowned.

336.speaker: Daria de Rava
336.text: "The King is diluting our thousand-year-old religious traditions, and you speak of holidays?"

339.speaker: Manus Sazon
339.text: "Of course that isn't the only benefit. We foresee great strides in Rizia's international relations in the wake of this decree."

340.speaker: Manus Sazon
340.text: "In light of our worsening tensions with Wehlen, it's important to send our Wehzek citizens the signal that they are still welcome here."

344.speaker: Manus Sazon
344.text: "In light of our new agreement with Wehlen, it's important to send our Wehzek citizens the signal that they are welcome here."

345.speaker: Player_Romus
345.text: "I signed the decree with an eye towards Rizians of Rumburgian descent. The opinion of Wehzeks is of no consequence."

346.speaker: Player_Romus
346.text: "Indeed. Our nation must unify beneath the umbrella of the great Nur."

347.speaker: Manus Sazon
347.text: "Well, the RPP regards it as an important side effect."

348.speaker: Player_Romus
348.text: "Yes, this will go a long way towards reducing animosity between ethnic Rizians and those of Wehzek descent."

350.speaker: Manus Sazon
350.text: "At the very least, we must not let religious differences divide us."

351.speaker: Daria de Rava
351.text: "Thank you, Mr. Sazon. You have made your position clear."

352.speaker: Daria de Rava
352.text: "While we are on the topic of religion..."

356.speaker: Daria de Rava
356.text: "I must mention the growing pressure from Golcondist communities to lift Rizia's blasphemy law."
356.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveStateReligion"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_NurityStateReligion"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveGolcondistBlasphemyLaw"] == true) == false)

357.speaker: Daria de Rava
357.text: "I must bring His Majesty's attention to to the aftermath of our lifting the Golcondist blasphemy law."
357.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveStateReligion"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_NurityStateReligion"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveGolcondistBlasphemyLaw"] == true)

361.speaker: Manus Sazon
361.text: "I must mention the growing pressure from Bludish and Derdian communities to lift our so-called blasphemy law."
361.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn07_InviteSalToHOD"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveStateReligion"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_NurityStateReligion"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveGolcondistBlasphemyLaw"] == true) == false)

362.speaker: Manus Sazon
362.text: "I must bring His Majesty's attention to the aftermath of our lifting the Golcondist blasphemy law."
362.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn07_InviteSalToHOD"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveStateReligion"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_NurityStateReligion"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveGolcondistBlasphemyLaw"] == true)

363.speaker: Daria de Rava
363.text: "The opposition speaker had some comments regarding what he sees as an 'encroachment of Wruhecism' onto everyday life."
363.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveStateReligion"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_NurityStateReligion"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true)

364.speaker: Daria de Rava
364.text: "I don't see the need to air these complaints."

365.speaker: Player_Romus
365.text: "It's always valuable to know the opposition's opinion. Go ahead, Mr. Sazon."

366.speaker: Player_Romus
366.text: "Nor do I. We shall not change the religious direction of this country, not when so many of our citizens are finally starting to welcome God into their lives."

367.speaker: Player_Romus
367.text: "I would be curious to know what blasphemous thoughts Mr. Sazon has rolling about in his head."

368.speaker: Narrator
368.text: Manus cleared his throat. He glanced uneasily at Sal.

377.speaker: Daria de Rava
377.text: "As the King proclaims, so it shall be."

379.speaker: Daria de Rava
379.text: "I will caution that several of the major Rumburgian corporations based in Rizia Imperii have voiced objections to the recently imposed tax on non-Wruhecists."

380.speaker: Daria de Rava
380.text: "However, they have signalled their willingness to comply for the sake of maintaining friendly business relations between our kingdoms."

384.speaker: Player_Romus
384.text: "They will see the light, or they will pay the price."

385.speaker: Player_Romus
385.text: "Rumburgian corporations are wealthy. They can afford it."

386.speaker: Player_Romus
386.text: "I'm sure there are all sorts of loopholes they can exploit if need be."

387.speaker: Player_Romus
387.text: "Good. We still need Rumburg on our side."

389.speaker: Daria de Rava
389.text: "The tax should not cost us the Queen's support. Not if we continue to help Rumburg in other ways."

393.speaker: Manus Sazon
393.text: "But I have received complaints from Dastnurist-owned businesses that have had to close since the tax on non-Wruhecists was introduced."

394.speaker: Manus Sazon
394.text: "But I have received complaints from Dastnurist Rizians who have had to pull their children out of school since our reforms were implemented."

395.speaker: Manus Sazon
395.text: "Ultimately, religion should have no place in the economy of a modern nation."

396.speaker: Manus Sazon
396.text: "Ultimately, a child's religious education should be decided on by their parents. Not mandated by the government."

397.speaker: Player_Romus
397.text: "I disagree. Our kingdom cannot prosper if it is suffering from spiritual bankruptcy."

398.speaker: Player_Romus
398.text: "But look at the income the tax generates. It can be used to help the less fortunate, in line with Wruhecist principles."

399.speaker: Player_Romus
399.text: "I stand by my decision. Businesses cannot take advantage of our resources while ignoring our values."

400.speaker: Player_Romus
400.text: "Heathens and blasphemers have no place in our economy, Mr. Sazon. They must submit to Wruhecism or pay the price."

401.speaker: Player_Romus
401.text: "Parents do not always know what is best for their children."

402.speaker: Player_Romus
402.text: "We are one of the few Wruhecist countries in this world. If we do not pass on our traditions, they will be lost."

403.speaker: Player_Romus
403.text: "The teachings of St. Wruhec are as valuable as reading, writing and arithmetic. They should be instilled in children regardless of what their parents believe."

407.speaker: Manus Sazon
407.text: "I cannot disagree with that, Your Majesty."

409.speaker: Manus Sazon
409.text: "No. But removing their right to determine their children's spiritual upbringing will foster resentment in the long run."

410.speaker: Player_Romus
410.text: "Providing each Rizian child with a Wruhecist education will foster a stronger sense of unity for future generations."

411.speaker: Manus Sazon
411.text: "Isn't that what our religious institutions are for? Using public schools for this purpose will only foster resentment in the long run."

412.speaker: Manus Sazon
412.text: "I worry that will foster an atmosphere of exclusion and resentment."

413.speaker: Manus Sazon
413.text: "Or it will foster an atmosphere of exclusion and resentment."

414.speaker: Daria de Rava
414.text: "I believe the King has made his position clear, Mr. Sazon. It is not up to you to debate it."

415.speaker: Manus Sazon
415.text: "But removing their right to determine their children's spiritual upbringing will foster resentment in the long run."

422.speaker: Narrator
422.text: Manus looked down. Daria smoothly continued.

423.speaker: Daria de Rava
423.text: "I will caution that several of the major Rumburgian corporations based in Rizia Imperii have voiced objections to the new tax."

424.speaker: Sal Ignacius
424.text: "There will be no exclusion when all accept Wruhecism as the one true faith, Mr. Sazon."

425.speaker: Sal Ignacius
425.text: "There will be no resentment when all accept Wruhecism as the one true faith, Mr. Sazon."

426.speaker: Daria de Rava
426.text: "Precisely, Your Majesty. The opposition is overlooking the decree's obvious benefits."

428.speaker: Daria de Rava
428.text: "However, they have signalled their willingness to comply for the sake of maintaining friendly business relations between our kingdoms."

429.speaker: Narrator
429.text: Frustration flashed across Manus' face. He kept it in check.

430.speaker: Manus Sazon
430.text: "Naturally, the Derdian and Bludish natives residing in Rizia have rejoiced at the opportunity to worship alongside their fellow Wruhecists."

431.speaker: Manus Sazon
431.text: "However, the general public remains skeptical about what they see as a legitimization of an extremist sect."

432.speaker: Manus Sazon
432.text: "It has helped soften the backlash against our border ban, which many say unfairly targets Golcondists."

436.speaker: Manus Sazon
436.text: "Together with the border ban we implemented in agreement with Wehlen, they point to it as evidence that the Crown discriminates against Golcondism."

440.speaker: Manus Sazon
440.text: "They point to it as evidence that the Crown discriminates against Golcondism."

441.speaker: Player_Romus
441.text: "A ridiculous accusation. Did I not allow Golcondist pilgrims to occupy the Plavo Archsanctuary?"

445.speaker: Player_Romus
445.text: "It is not discriminatory to crack down on terrorism."

446.speaker: Player_Romus
446.text: "Yes, and what is wrong with that? Golcondism is totally incompatible with modern Rizian society."

447.speaker: Player_Romus
447.text: "Lifting the blasphemy law has long been on my agenda. I will make it my priority."

448.speaker: Manus Sazon
448.text: "Yes, but it was expected that that action would be followed by a more general easing of restrictions on Golcondist worship."

449.speaker: Player_Romus
449.text: "Nonsense. I simply believe real Wruhecists have the right to worship in peace."

450.speaker: Player_Romus
450.text: "Golcondists are Wruhecists like any others. Their beliefs are as valid as yours or mine."

451.speaker: Manus Sazon
451.text: "We have no evidence that the Golcondists we are turning away are terrorists, Your Majesty."

452.speaker: Manus Sazon
452.text: "Some of its followers may hold problematic views. We cannot use that to justify denying rights to the Golcondist community as a whole."

453.speaker: Manus Sazon
453.text: "Granting all citizens an equal right to worship would be a great step forward for freedom in Rizia."

454.speaker: Manus Sazon
454.text: "Golcondists do consider themselves 'real' Wruhecists, Your Majesty."

455.speaker: Manus Sazon
455.text: "On the other hand, I understand public concerns about legitimizing what some see as an extremist sect."

456.speaker: Player_Romus
456.text: "I gave all Rizians an equal right to worship, regardless of religion. It's not like Golcondists are receiving special treatment."

460.speaker: Player_Romus
460.text: "The public has been scared away by decades of harmful stereotypes. They'll warm up to Golcondists in time."

461.speaker: Player_Romus
461.text: "We need Derdia's help in the war. Accepting Golcondists is all part of my strategy."

466.speaker: Narrator
466.text: The delegates turned to look at Sal.

467.speaker: Sal Ignacius
467.text: "I have made myself clear on this subject time and time again. By allowing Golcondists to flood our holy sites, we would be opening the door to darkness."

468.speaker: Manus Sazon
468.text: "Especially if Rizia is to reopen relations with Derdia, there are concerns about giving too much credence to Golcondist beliefs."

469.speaker: Player_Romus
469.text: "The concerns are over nothing. I don't want to have anything to do with Derdia."

473.speaker: Manus Sazon
473.text: "I agree, Your Majesty. I personally supported the lifting of the ban as a step forward for freedom in this country."

474.speaker: Manus Sazon
474.text: "That is my party's hope as well."

475.speaker: Manus Sazon
475.text: "The RPP is not opposed to dealing with Golcondist nations."

476.speaker: Manus Sazon
476.text: "Whatever the intention, I regard the lifting of the ban as a step forward for freedom in this country."

477.speaker: Manus Sazon
477.text: "But we must take care to ensure practitioners of other religions do not feel neglected."

479.speaker: Manus Sazon
479.text: "But there are those who are worried that if Rizia grants more rights to Golcondists, the kingdom will fall victim to the same ideologies as Derdia."

480.speaker: Manus Sazon
480.text: "There are those who are worried that if Rizia grants more rights to Golcondists, the kingdom will fall victim to the same ideologies as Derdia."

481.speaker: Player_Romus
481.text: "Even if the blasphemy law is revoked, Rizia will never turn into Derdia."

482.speaker: Player_Romus
482.text: "Would that be so bad? We have much to learn from our Derdian neighbors."

486.speaker: Player_Romus
486.text: "We may need Derdia's help in the war. But I will not make any ideological concessions to the Nurist republic."

487.speaker: Player_Romus
487.text: "These worries are unfounded. The blasphemy law is staying in place."

488.speaker: Manus Sazon
488.text: "I do not view the revocation of the blasphemy law as a concession."

489.speaker: Manus Sazon
489.text: "Yes, I also believe these fears are unfounded. The benefits of revoking the law outweigh the drawbacks."

490.speaker: Manus Sazon
490.text: "Your Majesty, there is a reason the Nurist republic has been diplomatically isolated since its founding."

491.speaker: Manus Sazon
491.text: "I still believe the benefits of revoking it outweigh the drawbacks."

492.speaker: Daria de Rava
492.text: "Naturally, the sudden acceptance of Derdian and Bludish worshippers in our sacred archsanctuaries has caused chaos within the Wruhecist community."

493.speaker: Daria de Rava
493.text: "However, the general public remains worried about the growing legitimization of this extremist sect."

494.speaker: Daria de Rava
494.text: "Admittedly, it has helped soften the backlash against our border ban on natives of those countries."

498.speaker: Player_Romus
498.text: "Golcondists are Wruhecists like any others. Their beliefs are as valid as yours or mine."

499.speaker: Player_Romus
499.text: "I gave all Rizians an equal right to worship, regardless of religion. It's not like Golcondists are receiving special treatment."

503.speaker: Player_Romus
503.text: "The public has been scared away by decades of harmful stereotypes. They'll warm up to Golcondists in time."

504.speaker: Player_Romus
504.text: "We need Derdia's help in the war. Accepting Golcondists is all part of my strategy."

505.speaker: Daria de Rava
505.text: "Especially ahead of Rizia's upcoming diplomatic visit to Derdia, there are concerns about giving too much credence to Golcondist beliefs."

506.speaker: Player_Romus
506.text: "The concerns are over nothing. Rizia will never turn into Derdia."

507.speaker: Daria de Rava
507.text: "Our respected religious leaders would beg to disagree. Including the Grand Wiseman."

509.speaker: Narrator
509.text: The Delegates turned to look at Sal.

513.speaker: Daria de Rava
513.text: "Many religious leaders, our Grand Wiseman included, would call their presence a threat to mainstream Wruhecism."

514.speaker: Daria de Rava
514.text: "Their fears about Golcondists are based on more than mere stereotypes."

515.speaker: Daria de Rava
515.text: "No. Not as long as the majority of our citizens still oppose Golcondism."

516.speaker: Daria de Rava
516.text: "I respect that. But we must be careful not to align with them too much."

520.speaker: Sal Ignacius
520.text: "By accepting Golcondist worshippers, we have opened the door to darkness."

522.speaker: Daria de Rava
522.text: "Together with the border ban we implemented in agreement with Wehlen, they point to it as evidence that the Crown discriminates against Golcondism."

526.speaker: Player_Romus
526.text: "Still, I find the accusations worrying. I do not want my citizens to feel discriminated against."

527.speaker: Player_Romus
527.text: "Good. Because I have no intention of lifting it."

528.speaker: Manus Sazon
528.text: "I must object, your Majesty. We have no proof that the Golcondists we are turning away at the border are terrorists."

529.speaker: Manus Sazon
529.text: "I must object, Your Majesty. We cannot use the problematic views of a few followers to justify denying rights to the Golcondist community as a whole."

530.speaker: Manus Sazon
530.text: "My party agrees, Your Majesty. Granting all citizens an equal right to worship would be a great step forward for freedom in Rizia."

531.speaker: Manus Sazon
531.text: "I must object, Your Majesty. Even if Golcondists make up a minority of society, they deserve the right to worship like anyone else."

535.speaker: Daria de Rava
535.text: "They point to it as evidence that the Crown discriminates against Golcondism."

536.speaker: Player_Romus
536.text: "What's wrong with discrimination against Golcondists? Their faith is totally incompatible with modern Rizian society."

537.speaker: Player_Romus
537.text: "It is not discriminatory to crack down on terrorism."

538.speaker: Daria de Rava
538.text: "However, these complaints are only coming from a fraction of the populace. The majority want our law to stay in place."

543.speaker: Narrator
543.text: The delegates turned to look at Sal.

544.speaker: Sal Ignacius
544.text: "I have made myself clear on this subject time and time again. By allowing Golcondists to flood our holy sites, we would be opening the door to darkness."

549.speaker: Daria de Rava
549.text: "We have seen the influence of Golcondism on our neighbor Derdia. Our citizens do not want Rizia to fall victim to the same fate."

550.speaker: Player_Romus
550.text: "Even if the blasphemy law is revoked, Rizia will never turn into Derdia. Our traditions are too strong."

551.speaker: Player_Romus
551.text: "Would that be so bad? We have much to learn from Supreme Wiseman Azmal and his people."

553.speaker: Daria de Rava
553.text: "Your Majesty, there is a reason the Nurist republic has been diplomatically isolated since its founding."

554.speaker: Narrator
554.text: I saw Hugo raise his eyebrow.

555.speaker: Narrator
555.text: My uncle looked relieved. He nodded emphatically.

556.speaker: Narrator
556.text: Out of the corner of my eye, I saw Hugo nod emphatically.

557.speaker: Player_Romus
557.text: "I admit we need Derdia's help in the war. But I will not make any ideological concessions to them."
